text: PR #5436 (#5427) round 3 fix (commit 68354825c): a second adversarial review pass found the round-2 rename-detection re-walk reused containment_denied instead of a distinct code, conflating a genuine TOCTOU-attack signal with the mundane initial-denial meaning that code has elsewhere in the function -- masking exactly the security event the fix exists to catch from audit logs. Fixed by switching to the existing artifact_changed value (already used by this file's own revalidate function) with a new changed_during_admission diagnostic, mirroring the sibling polyglot_artifact_admission.cpp's established convention. Tightened the regression test to assert the specific error code. Judged a 4th adversarial review round unnecessary given the small, mechanical nature of this fix. Exact-head Windows Native Validation redispatched (run 33478633349), will merge once green. Recap of #5427's full journey: round 1 (bot review) found the migration needed the same post-read path re-walk fix #5426 needed, since the inline expected_sha256 check protects bytes-via-handle but not the returned resolved_path_'s continued binding for a caller that doesn't revalidate; round 2 fixed the error-code conflation just described.
